candidates.title: Delayed Project Check-in
candidates.goal: Acknowledge the colleague's constraint, propose a practical next step, and confirm shared understanding.
candidates.user_role: Project lead who needs to address the delay and agree on a revised plan.
candidates.ai_role: Colleague who is responsible for the delayed task and has a valid reason for the setback.

candidates.title: Client Deadline Negotiation
candidates.goal: Acknowledge the client's concern, justify a new timeline based on a shared constraint, and ensure alignment.
candidates.user_role: Project manager who needs to explain the delay and negotiate a new deadline.
candidates.ai_role: Client account manager who is concerned about the delay and needs a clear plan.

candidates.title: Team Retrospective on Delay
candidates.goal: Acknowledge a team member's valid point, propose a process improvement based on it, and confirm team alignment.
candidates.user_role: Team facilitator who guides the discussion and helps the team agree on improvements.
candidates.ai_role: Team member who raises a concern about the delay and suggests a different approach.
